features: Every US-stock analysis now reloads the R2 Pionex symbol list and keeps only contracts tagged trade_time_7_24.
Contracts with 5x7, 5x24, delayed-open/early-close, offline, unknown, or missing 7x24 metadata are excluded from the analysis universe.
If R2 is temporarily unavailable, the last-known-safe fallback is also restricted to a 7x24 whitelist so休市標的不會混回圖表.
The per-chart 7×24 market-session capsule and its recurring market-status request are no longer used because every analyzed US-stock chart is now 7×24-only.
